Name: TC_REC_Candidate_Email_001 (positive): Verify system accepts valid email formats with subaddressing
Precondition:
PRE-CONDITIONS

* Navigate to the OrangeHRM system.

* Ensure the user is logged in with a valid Admin or Recruiter account.

* Ensure the candidate data requirements are prepared for input.

* Access the module: Recruitment > Candidates > Add Candidate

REQUIREMENTS

Valid Candidate First and Last Name Valid Email String with Subaddressing
Character (e.g., user+tag@domain.com) Complete Mandatory Form Fields

EXPECTED RESULTS

* System shall validate the extended email syntax successfully.

* System shall save the candidate profile without triggering formatting
errors.

* System shall preserve the full email text including the plus (+)
character intact.

* System shall display the saved email accurately in the candidate
details view.

* System shall maintain data integrity within the persistent database
registry.
Objective:
This test case verifies that the Recruitment module accepts and processes
candidate registrations containing extended email address formats with
subaddressing characters (the + sign) when valid candidate data is used.
The test ensures that the system handles complex syntax, database storage,
and input fields to provide a robust data validation experience.
Expected Result:
* The OrangeHRM login page loads successfully.
* The login interface is displayed correctly.
* The user is authenticated successfully.

Name: TC_REC_Candidate_Email_002 (negative): Verify system rejects email formats with missing suffixes
Precondition:
PRE-CONDITIONS

* Navigate to the OrangeHRM system.

* Ensure the user is logged in with a valid Admin or Recruiter account.


* Ensure the system is ready to receive input data. Access the module:
Recruitment > Candidates > Add Candidate

REQUIREMENTS

Valid Candidate First and Last Name Invalid Email String Missing Domain
Suffix (e.g., user@) Attempt to Execute Form Submission

EXPECTED RESULTS

* System shall block the candidate profile registration successfully.

* System shall trigger an inline error message indicating an invalid
email format.

* System shall highlight the email input field boundary to capture
user attention.

* System shall restrict database insertion to prevent corrupted or
partial records.

* System shall preserve the entered string in the field for user
correction.
Objective:
This test case verifies that the Recruitment module blocks candidate
registrations and restricts form submissions when an incomplete or
syntactically invalid email structure is used. The test ensures that the
input validation engine, error indicators, inline alerts, and overall
boundary rules provide a secure data entry experience.
Expected Result:
* The OrangeHRM login page loads successfully.
* The login interface is displayed correctly.
* The user is authenticated successfully.
